comingSoon.title: Coming soon
comingSoon.text: This part of the app is being built. Check back in the next version.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.placeholder: The full privacy policy will be published before the public launch.

pitch.title: Gifts that delight. No duplicates.
pitch.subtitle: Collect what you'd like to get and share your lists with family and friends.
pitch.paste: Paste a shop link — the name, price and photo fill in by themselves.
pitch.share: Share with your circles — family, friends or via a link.
pitch.surprise: Surprises stay surprises — you'll never see what someone reserved.

password.rule: At least 10 characters. Easiest with a few words, e.g. puss-in-boots-2027.

strengthHint.weak: Too short or too simple — add a few characters.
strengthHint.medium: Add another word or a number.

validation.emailInvalid: That doesn't look like an email address.
validation.passwordTooShort: The password is too short — it needs at least 10 characters.
validation.passwordsDiffer: The passwords don't match. Please type them again.
validation.displayNameRequired: Enter how your family and friends should see you.
validation.consentRequired: Tick the box to create an account.

login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: Welcome back! Your lists are waiting.
login.failedText: The email or password is incorrect. Check them and try again.
login.oauthFailed: Signing in with Google didn't work. Please try again.

register.title: Create an account
register.displayNameHint: This is how your family and friends will see you.
register.consent: I accept the {policy} and know how my data is processed.
register.emailTaken: An account with this address already exists. Log in or reset your password.

inbox.title: Check your inbox
inbox.text: We've sent a link to {email}. Click it to confirm your address. The link is valid for 24 hours.
inbox.spamHint: Can't see the email? Check your “Promotions” or “Spam” folder.

verify.successText: Thank you! You can now share lists, invite your family and friends, and reserve gifts.
verify.expiredText: Confirmation links are valid for 24 hours. We'll send you a new one — it only takes a moment.
verify.loginToResend: Log in to get a new link
verify.resent: We've sent a new link to {email}.
verify.bannerText: Click the link we sent to {email}. Until then you can add 5 items — sharing and reservations unlock once you confirm.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.text: Enter your account's email address. We'll send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sentText: If there's an account for {email}, we've sent it a link to change the password. The link is valid for 1 hour.
forgot.sentHint: Nothing arrived? Check your “Spam” folder or make sure it's the right address.
forgot.googleHint: Do you sign in with Google? Then you don't need a password — {link}.
forgot.googleHintLink: go back and choose “Continue with Google”

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.logoutNote: After the change we'll log you out on all devices.
reset.expiredText: For security, a password reset link is valid for 1 hour and can be used only once. Ask for a new one.
reset.doneText: Log in with your new password.

details.title: Your details
details.avatarHint: We show your initials instead of a photo.
details.displayNameHint: This is how people in your circles see you.

language.title: App and email language
language.hint: Applies to the app, emails and notifications.

signIn.title: Sign-in methods
signIn.lastMethodGoogle: This is your only sign-in method, so it can't be disconnected. Set a password first.
signIn.lastMethodPassword: This is your only sign-in method, so it can't be removed.
signIn.otherDevicesNote: After the change we'll log you out on other devices.
signIn.passwordRemoved: Password removed. You sign in with Google.
signIn.removePasswordText: You'll sign in only with Google. You can set a password again at any time.
signIn.unlinkGoogleText: You'll sign in only with your password. You can connect Google again at any time.

errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some fields are not filled in correctly.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don't have access to this resource.
errors.CSRF_INVALID: Your session expired or the request is invalid. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.CONFLICT: The data was changed in the meantime. Refresh and try again.
errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many attempts. Please try again in a moment.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again later.
errors.EMAIL_TAKEN: An account with this email address already exists.
errors.TOKEN_INVALID_OR_EXPIRED: This link has expired or has already been used.
errors.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Please confirm your email address first.
errors.LAST_LOGIN_METHOD: This is the only way to log in to your account, so it can't be removed.
errors.PROVIDER_ALREADY_LINKED: This Google account is already connected to another account.
errors.NETWORK: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
